To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Year-end support ask: premium SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Marcus,

Hope you had a good holiday weekend. Quick one — our product team saw a significant uptake this quarter and were forecasting sustained 2x token volume for Q1 (most traffic from our new realtime assistant). Before we finalize our budget, we need confirmation from Redwood on two things for a year-end commitment:

- Premium SLA addendum (latency SLO target: p95 < 180ms for standard gen paths, 99.9% availability)
- Dedicated capacity pool to guarantee throughput during peak windows (were proposing a 2x bump to our reserved units)

Can you confirm whether those can be included in a 12-month term amendment and what the uplift to our committed spend would be? If helpful I attached our Q3 usage snapshot.

Wed like to sign before Dec 15 if possible.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform
Nexera Analytics
Olivia Park | 415-555-0129

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Year-end support ask: premium SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Olivia — appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the growth. This is workable and weve done similar upgrades for other customers. High level plan:

1) SLA addendum: we can provide a premium SLA addendum that includes a latency SLO (p95 < 180ms for your primary model routes) and a 99.9% availability target. The addendum will include rollback/fallback policies to lower-cost model variants in case of broad infra impacts.

2) Dedicated capacity: we can reserve a dedicated GPU pool for Nexera and size it to a 2x uplift. That will give predictable throughput and priority scheduling during peaks.

3) Commercials & term: for a 12-month committed amendment wed propose a blended uplift to committed spend and a one-time onboarding retainer to cover capacity reservation and runbook alignment. I need to confirm exact numbers with procurement (ccd Neha) but expect a mid-single-digit percentage uplift relative to current committed spend per unit for the reserved pool, plus a small setup fee.

Next steps: Ill loop in Neha for a formal addendum and Lauren to scope the onboarding runbook and oncall cadence. I attached the usage snapshot you sent and our draft addendum we can iterate on. Can you confirm that Dec 15 is the target signature date?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 510-555-4500

Attachments: Usage_Report_Q3.csv (CSV), SLA_Addendum_draft.docx (DOCX)

To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:21:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Nexera year-end ask — procurement & CS action items

Neha / Lauren, forwarding Olivia's request (below). TL;DR: customer wants premium SLA + dedicated pool sized ~2x current reserved units, wants to sign by Dec 15.

Action items:
- Neha: please draft a 12-month amendment with pricing options for (A) 2x reserved pool, (B) 1.5x reserved pool, and the setup/onboarding fee. Include a term-sheet-friendly clause for rollback/fallback to lower-cost model variants. We should include a standard SLA credit table and a short list of operational exclusions.
- Lauren: prepare a short onboarding runbook (1-2 pages) describing the capacity onramp, alerting & escalation matrix, and the proposed oncall schedule for Q1. Also add any suggested proof points for our latency targets (benchmarks, canary plan).

I've attached the draft addendum I started. Please mark changes inline and we can finalize before I send to Olivia.

Thanks — Marcus
